name: Hearers
overview: The Scriptures reveal that hearers of God's word may listen attentively and even express outward affection, yet fail to obey, as seen in Ezekiel where the people hear the prophet's words but do not act on them, their hearts pursuing selfish desires. Jesus further contrasts those who hear His sayings and put them into practice with those who do not, likening the former to a wise man building on a rock, and the latter to a foolish man building on sand. Thus, true hearing involves not only receiving the word but also living in obedience to it.
